title: Event envelope, version 1
description: Every v1 event is this envelope around one data object. All fields are required; a value that does not apply is null, never missing. Unknown fields are refused, so a consumer quarantines a message it does not understand instead of guessing.

event_id.description: Unique per logical event; a redelivery keeps the same ID.

event_type.description: Event name without the version, for example research.assessment.completed.

published_at.description: When the producer published the event.

correlation_id.description: Shared by every event of one flow; platform-core uses the W3C trace ID of the request that started it.

causation_id.description: ID of the event or command that directly caused this one.

account_id.description: Account the event belongs to, or null when it is not account-scoped.

data.description: Event-specific payload; each event schema defines it exactly.
